elements.description:
A heatmap of checks × parts – covered, partial or gap – with totals, a legend with counts, and a cell's detail on
Enter or click.

properties.name: heading
properties.description: The heading, and the grid's name

properties.name: checks
properties.description: The rows: what does the covering – tests, controls, policies

properties.name: parts
properties.description: The columns: what gets covered – components, systems, models

properties.name: coverage
properties.description: Each cell's status, with optional detail and evidence

properties.name: open
properties.description: The cell whose detail is open. Changed by the user unless a tc-open-change listener calls preventDefault()

properties.name: partialWeight
properties.description: How much a partial cell counts towards a total, from 0 to 1

properties.name: statusLabels
properties.description: The statuses' names, merged over the defaults (Covered, Partial, Gap, Not applicable)

properties.name: checkLabel
properties.description: The heading of the checks column

properties.name: totalLabel
properties.description: The heading of the totals column and row

properties.name: look
properties.description: Visual style: "standard" or "clean"; unset follows <tc-look-provider>, else "standard"

events.name: tc-open-change
events.description: A cell's detail opened or closed ({ open, cell }: CoverageOpenChange); cancelable – prevented, `open` stays as it was

functions.name: defaultCoverageStatusLabels
functions.description: The statuses' names used when the page gives none

props.name: title
props.description: The heading, and the grid's name

props.name: open
props.description: The cell whose detail is open – controlled when given (null for none)

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: The cell open on mount when `open` isn't controlled

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: A cell's detail opened or closed; `cell` is the opened cell
